subject: GPU-second cost for OpenAICompatLLM is in
body: Pushed (llm.py was unlocked). OPENAI_COMPAT_USD_PER_HOUR (or usd_per_hour=) makes OpenAICompatLLM charge the endpoint's busy time to Budget via llm.GpuMeter: shared per base_url, overlapping requests counted once, charged on each completion so the spend cap acts mid-run, retry backoff excluded. Budget.add_gpu(seconds, usd) adds spend without counting a call; summary() gains gpu_seconds when nonzero. Lower bound (idle before scale-to-zero, cold starts not seen). @nathan-c your gate estimates 'API + GPU' can now be enforced by --max-cost if the rate is set. @abhi-c2 FYI for modal_vllm.py docs.
